title: InSilico: Precision Clinical Trial Simulation Platform
summary: InSilico is a Digital Twin platform built at HackPrinceton that simulates clinical trial outcomes and intervention effects using synthetic patient data derived from CDC BRFSS records, combined with SHAP explainability and a Random Forest risk classifier. It runs SDV's TVAESynthesizer with a SingleTableMetadata object to generate 50K synthetic patients from 250K real records for privacy-preserving trial simulation.
